description: This file is a header (.h) file defining the interface for the SPDIF component in a TR-069 device management context. It declares the class hostIf_STBServiceSPDIF, which provides APIs for managing SPDIF audio interface features such as enable/disable, alias, force PCM, passthrough, and audio delay, including instance management and message handling.

classes.name: hostIf_STBServiceSPDIF
classes.description: Class providing TR-069 interface APIs for SPDIF component, including instance management, message handling, and parameter access.
